item.title: Weeds growing around Bollards on Lobleys Drive opposite Tescos, 4th September
item.description:
I have met with an Environmental Services Officer at Tewkesbury BC to discuss a number of street cleaning issues within Coopers Edge. In the case of this issue, TBC consider this is not a street cleaning issue and is the responsibility of the Highway Authority. It would be appreciated if you could arrange to meet with TBC to agree the respective responsibilities of the two authorities and resolve this issue as soon as possible.
